01 /

A place to follow the action

Explore games published by administrators, make your own selections or follow the future picks of a copy strategy. The platform supports sports match-winner markets and shows the odds available for each event.

02 /

Your activity, connected

Your wallet, stakes, copy chart and transaction history work together. Results are settled from the final scores entered by an administrator. Payment and verification statuses show where a request stands.

03 /

Support inside your account

The built-in account assistant can answer supported questions using your own account records. Ask to speak with an administrator when you need a person. Support cannot promise outcomes or remove the risks of staking.

Find help ↗
04 /

Stay in control

EDGE is for adults aged 18 and over. Staking involves financial risk, including the loss of your entire stake or copy allocation. Use only funds you can afford to lose and take a break when you need one.
